full/powershell/vscode/ollama-embed/open.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. if (-not (Test-Path .gitignore)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path .gitignore | Out-Null } Add-Content -Path .gitignore -Value '.chunkhound.json' # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and OpenRouter for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ # You'll need: OpenRouter API key @' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "openrouter", "model": "poolside/laguna-s-2.1", "api_key": "<YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY>" } } '@ | Set-Content -Path '.chunkhound.json' -Encoding utf8 # Configure VS Code to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if (Test-Path '.vscode/mcp.json') { Write-Host @' .vscode/mcp.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "servers": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "stdio", "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } '@ } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.vscode' | Out-Null @' { "servers": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "stdio", "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } '@ | Set-Content -Path '.vscode/mcp.json' -Encoding utf8 }
